# Human Reader Edition {.unnumbered}

This is the maintained draft of the independent 26-unit Human Reader edition. Every unit is drafted and inside its pacing range. Narrative completeness requires review of the mechanism, alternative, example, failure, and conclusion; target length alone does not establish it. Author approval and major-version release remain separate gates. The live technical book remains the claim, proof, evidence, and source authority.

The narrative develops three proposed contributions: **governed-cognition interface contracts**, **public claim-state transition discipline**, and **record/reality reconciliation with residual honesty**. The 89 technical owners support these composition and process proposals; they are not independent discoveries. Bounded local implementation results do not establish general superiority, novelty, or chapter-core support. The [contribution summary](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/docs/three_defended_contributions.md) and [conventional alternatives](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/docs/defended_contribution_prior_art_positioning.md) give the scope and challengers.

Start with [A Fifteen-Minute Route Through the Stack](quickstart.qmd) to run one bounded governed repository change and inspect what is implemented, what remains proposed, and how the three execution routes differ.

- [Decompose the request](chapters/unit-01-asi-is-a-stack-not-a-model.qmd#one-request-many-commitments).

- [Separate restoration from downstream remedy](chapters/unit-17-artifact-graphs-runtime-effects-and-operations.qmd#recovery-compensation-and-closure).

- [Decide whether a lesson becomes durable](chapters/unit-21-adjudicated-persistence-generalization-feedback-continual-learning-and-unlearning.qmd#the-adaptive-commit-boundary).

- [Follow the integrated request](chapters/unit-26-integrated-reference-architecture-project-theseus-and-the-living-research-method.qmd#following-the-repository-change).

Search in this edition covers the current narrative. For specialist contracts, sources, or papers, follow the glossary's technical-owner links or switch to the AI / researcher edition. Historical releases retain their own status; a matching term does not make an old result current.

## Find the Owner of a Source or Defect {#find-an-owner}

Choose the responsibility where the first disputed meaning or decision arises. A misread request belongs to Human Intent; a plan that changes an accepted obligation belongs to conformance or Planning; an unknown external outcome belongs to Runtime. A source can inform several owners, and its volume does not create a chapter. A genuinely new responsibility still needs the established chapter-admission review.

Expand a narrative unit below to see the distinct jobs of its technical owners, their inputs and outputs, and the closest neighboring responsibilities. These are authored architectural roles from the maintained book outline, not proof that an implementation or scientific claim is established. A logical owner need not be a separate service, model or institution.

<details class="owner-routes"><summary>Unit 1 — ASI Is a Stack, Not a Model</summary>

Read the [narrative explanation](chapters/unit-01-asi-is-a-stack-not-a-model.qmd) or follow an exact technical owner:

**[ASI Is a Stack, Not a Model](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/asi-is-a-stack-not-a-model.html)**

Explain and challenge the stack thesis: which logical responsibilities must remain inspectable across a handoff, and when a competent conventional design is sufficient.

Human purposes, constraints and candidate architecture roles enter; a responsibility map and conditions for accepting, narrowing or rejecting the stack proposal leave. This is the conceptual frame, not an artifact ledger or service blueprint. Integrated Reference Architecture owns the joined trace across the roles; this opener explains why the distinctions might earn their burden.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Integrated Reference Architecture](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/integrated-reference-architecture.html).

</details>

<details class="owner-routes"><summary>Unit 2 — The Efficient ASI Hypothesis</summary>

Read the [narrative explanation](chapters/unit-02-the-efficient-asi-hypothesis.qmd) or follow an exact technical owner:

**[The Efficient ASI Hypothesis](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/the-efficient-asi-hypothesis.html)**

State the conditions under which selective cognition could improve accepted useful work per complete resource bill without weakening the task or hiding risk.

Task quality requirements, candidate routes and full cost/outcome accounts enter; a bounded efficiency comparison and its weakening conditions leave. Resource Economics owns the accounting and allocation contract, while Routing selects an eligible worker. This chapter owns the hypothesis about their joint frontier, not an optimizer or a claim that the cheaper visible meter wins.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Resource Economics and Token Budgets](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/resource-economics-and-token-budgets.html); [Routing Heads and Specialist Cores](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/routing-heads-and-specialist-cores.html).

</details>

<details class="owner-routes"><summary>Unit 3 — Authority, Failure, and Misuse</summary>

Read the [narrative explanation](chapters/unit-03-authority-failure-and-misuse.qmd) or follow an exact technical owner:

**[System Boundaries and Authority](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/system-boundaries-and-authority.html)**

Define the exact permission relation for a principal, operation, target and current grant, including delegation, expiry, revocation and the effect ceiling.

A requested use and applicable grants enter; the authority tuple and admission/denial obligations leave. Runtime Adapters owns the actual effect boundary, attempts and outcome observation. Route an incorrectly interpreted or widened grant here; route a correctly defined grant that was not enforced at the effect boundary to Runtime, preserving both owners when the defect crosses them.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Runtime Adapters, Tool Permissions, and Human Approval](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/runtime-adapters-tool-permissions-and-human-approval.html).

**[Failure Modes of Ungoverned Intelligence](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/failure-modes-of-ungoverned-intelligence.html)**

Define the failure conditions that make an architectural claim challengeable, including unmapped events, near misses, recurrence and escape.

Declared invariants, threat assumptions and event reports enter; a versioned failure map, detection obligations and unresolved classifications leave. Operations owns incident response, while Adversarial Evaluation owns the validity of a challenge. A taxonomy entry is an obligation to investigate, not evidence that a detector found the event or containment worked.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Governed Operations, Incident Command, and Graceful Degradation](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/governed-operations-incident-command-and-graceful-degradation.html); [Adversarial Evaluation, Sandbagging, and Training-Time Deception](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-evaluation-sandbagging-and-training-time-deception.html).

**[Dangerous Capability Domains and Misuse Uplift](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/dangerous-capability-domains-and-misuse-uplift.html)**

Bound dangerous capability by domain, actor, access, elicitation, safeguards and uplift over the declared alternative.

Threat models, task cohorts, realistic comparators and observations enter; a scoped capability/uplift dossier with uncertainty leaves. Capability Thresholds owns the commitment triggered by that dossier; Societal Resilience owns defensive response. Route a misleading domain measurement here, a wrong trigger consequence to Thresholds, and an inadequate public defense to Resilience. The dossier grants no deployment authority.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Capability Thresholds and Deployment Commitments](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/capability-thresholds-and-deployment-commitments.html); [Societal Resilience and Misuse Defense](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/societal-resilience-and-misuse-defense.html).

**[Military AI, Autonomous Weapons, and Strategic Stability](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/military-ai-autonomous-weapons-and-strategic-stability.html)**

Assess the composed command-and-interaction boundary where military AI joins human authority, physical action, adversary response and escalation timing.

Mission limits, command records, operator and sensor evidence, applicable constraints and interaction assumptions enter; a bounded strategic/control assessment and unresolved obligations leave. Dangerous Capabilities owns actor-level uplift; Embodied Agency owns deadline-bound actuation. Neither accurate targeting nor a secure actuator establishes lawful command, human comprehension or strategic stability; those remain separate judgments.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Dangerous Capability Domains and Misuse Uplift](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/dangerous-capability-domains-and-misuse-uplift.html); [Embodied Agency, Real-Time Control, and Physical Safety](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/embodied-agency-real-time-control-and-physical-safety.html).

</details>

<details class="owner-routes"><summary>Unit 4 — Security, Privacy, and AI Artifact Custody</summary>

Specify threat-bound mediation of privileged information flows and effects, including exposure, declassification, revocation and incident limits.

A threat model, principals, current capabilities, data labels and requested uses enter; bounded admission/denial and flow/effect obligations leave. Runtime Adapters owns concrete effect attempts; Adversarial Machine Learning owns attacks on learned behavior. Valid receipt shape is not an enforced isolation boundary, and sanitization cannot silently become declassification authority.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Runtime Adapters, Tool Permissions, and Human Approval](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/runtime-adapters-tool-permissions-and-human-approval.html); [Adversarial Machine Learning and the Model Attack Surface](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-machine-learning-and-model-attack-surface.html).

**[Adversarial Machine Learning and the Model Attack Surface](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-machine-learning-and-model-attack-surface.html)**

Bind attacks and defenses on learned behavior to exact artifacts, attacker knowledge, objectives, budgets, adaptation and observed consequences.

Build/deployment identity, threat specifications and bounded attack/defense observations enter; model-threat findings and defense tradeoffs leave. Security Kernel owns application/tool authority boundaries; Adversarial Evaluation owns test elicitation and evaluator deception. Authentic provenance does not rule out poisoned behavior, and an attack result cannot certify the entire system insecure or secure.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Security Kernel and Digital SCIFs](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/security-kernel-and-digital-scifs.html); [Adversarial Evaluation, Sandbagging, and Training-Time Deception](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-evaluation-sandbagging-and-training-time-deception.html).

**[Privacy, Data Rights, and Information-Flow Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/privacy-data-rights-and-information-flow-governance.html)**

Keep purpose compatibility, minimization, information rights and remedy duties attached to data use and known derivatives across the lifecycle.

Affected parties, purpose/rights constraints, flow lineage and privacy evidence enter; scoped use/remedy decisions, propagation duties and unresolved exposure leave. Data Engines owns data/training/deletion events; Confidential Computation owns protected-execution properties. Encryption, consent metadata or a deletion receipt cannot settle purpose legitimacy, privacy loss or closure across unknown copies.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Data Engines, Continual Learning, and Unlearning](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/data-engines-continual-learning-and-unlearning.html); [Confidential and Verifiable AI Computation](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/confidential-and-verifiable-ai-computation.html).

**[Confidential and Verifiable AI Computation](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/confidential-and-verifiable-ai-computation.html)**

Separate privacy, computation integrity, platform identity and output authenticity when AI work crosses distrust boundaries.

An exact workload, protection goals, adversary assumptions, protocol/platform evidence and permitted use enter; a bounded protected-execution appraisal and limitations leave. Privacy owns purpose and rights; Model-Weight Custody owns keys, assets and roots of trust. A protected platform or valid computation proof cannot certify all those properties at once or grant the relying party’s action.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Privacy, Data Rights, and Information-Flow Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/privacy-data-rights-and-information-flow-governance.html); [Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/model-weight-custody-and-hardware-roots-of-trust.html).

**[Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/model-weight-custody-and-hardware-roots-of-trust.html)**

Track possession, access, copies, derivatives, keys, load state and retirement of exact model-family assets across custody boundaries.

Asset/holder inventories, current access rules, key state, attestation appraisal and copy/load observations enter; scoped custody transitions and surviving-copy residuals leave. Supply Chain owns build/supplier integrity; Open-Weight Release owns deliberate irreversible distribution. Custody or hardware appraisal cannot establish model safety, complete derivative discovery or authority to publish the weights.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [AI Supply-Chain Integrity and Lifecycle Provenance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/ai-supply-chain-integrity-and-lifecycle-provenance.html); [Open-Weight Release and Post-Release Control](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/open-weight-release-and-post-release-control.html).

**[Open-Weight Release and Post-Release Control](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/open-weight-release-and-post-release-control.html)**

Treat deliberate weight distribution as a change in controllability, with explicit recall limits and post-release obligations.

Exact release artifacts, bounded misuse evidence, commitments, institutional decisions and resilience limits enter; a scoped release disposition and irreversible residuals leave. Weight Custody owns restricted possession/access; Societal Resilience owns downstream defense and remedy. Revoking official availability does not retract independent copies, and a complete release packet cannot automatically authorize publication.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/model-weight-custody-and-hardware-roots-of-trust.html); [Societal Resilience and Misuse Defense](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/societal-resilience-and-misuse-defense.html).

Appraise exact lifecycle subjects and relations under a consumer’s integrity policy, including affected paths, invalidation and bounded restoration.

Build/data/model identities, supplier assertions, provenance, advisories and verification policy enter; scoped assurance/affected-path decisions and unresolved coverage leave. Artifact Graphs preserves general lineage and replay; Weight Custody governs possession/use of model-family assets. A signature or BOM is an assertion to appraise, not artifact correctness, complete dependency coverage or release permission.

**Nearest overlapping owners:** [Artifact Graphs, Audit Logs, and Replay](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/artifact-graphs-audit-logs-and-replay.html); [Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/model-weight-custody-and-hardware-roots-of-trust.html).

Read the [narrative explanation](chapters/unit-06-human-intent-control-and-epistemic-security.qmd) or follow an exact technical owner:

**[Human Intent as a Formal Input](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/human-intent-as-a-formal-input.html)**

Make the interpretation of a request contestable: bind the desired outcome, permitted means, current authorization, unacceptable effects, acceptance and unresolved ambiguity.
